The Leibniz Prize winners who did not win the Nobel Prize had earlier success than those who went on to be Nobel winners.

specificFindings: Jordan and Morgan supply broader-sport-background alternatives to the earlier examples. For every is rhetorical contrast rather than a precise one-to-one population frequency or random assignment.

Jordan baseball,football,basketball differs from Morgans volleyball,track,soccer. Jordans two-year basketball sabbatical during mourning is not permanent withdrawal from all sports or Morgans club-entry age.

The later-start comparison is limited to adult elite competition and contrasted with junior success. Short-term translates to success does not promise long-term certainty; not always pay off is not never.

Youth-led play outside the primary sport is associated with higher adult performance. The passage does not report randomly forcing all children to stop coached practice or a universal causal guarantee.

The science comparison is a separate professional-domain study, not the same athlete sample.48 German Nobel laureates in named fields are compared with Leibniz winners; prize assignment is not randomised.

The early-success statement qualifies Leibniz winners who did not later win Nobel. Scholarship as students is one relative marker, not proof the other group never received scholarships or equal award amounts.
Diverse exploration and slower progress contrast with eventual high achievement in the authors synthesis; this is not a guarantee every slow career reaches the top.

Nietzsche attribution,essay title,Ecce Homo and Germany criticism remain exactly as printed. The quotation is philosophy/literature, not a controlled experiment, population census or universal career-failure law.
A moment corrected to five or six hours magnifies temporary escape in the quoted rhetoric. Opium is metaphorical, not a medical dose or evidence every listener has identical effects.

Cautionary tale introduces a warning through early exceptional promise; question16 does not require the later outcome absent from that parent excerpt. Often considered transfers a reputation, not a new universal IQ measurement.

The MIT professor in attendance voiced a future prediction at the lecture; Harvard is the lecture setting, not a substituted employer. Prediction wrong contrasts with burnout without denying earlier examinations or claiming every gifted child has the same outcome.
Burned out is exhaustion or lost drive, not literal fire injury or an invented clinical diagnosis. Might and could in the next explanatory sentence retain possibility.

Ohtani schedule details are explicitly the books narrative, not current-season verification. Most games modifies hitting and at least once a week modifies pitching; grit,confidence and also playfulness remain additive.

The3-for24,.125 statistic belongs to the2022 hitting start, not all career/pitching or fresh current results. Might make a player feel depressed is a possible low-mood reaction, not a diagnosis of every player or measured private state of Ohtani.

All12 inherited parent English/Chinese pairs were read from compact source preview and checked for full translation, cross-page continuity, case-versus-study status, timing, comparisons, modifiers, literary attribution and inferential limits.

Question24 uses its precise statistic target;25 includes only the first two exact sentences needed for the statistic-reference possibility question. Later humour and outcome sentences remain unassigned if not previously evidenced; planned-evidence guard passes.
